rule: ml-baseline-1: linked matches only. Both platforms usable -> smaller bid/ask spread; tie -> larger best-level depth (best-bid size + best-ask size); tie -> Polymarket. One usable -> it. None usable -> no baseline ('Market probability unavailable'), never 50%. Usable = current (latest refresh, <= 180 s, market open) AND two-sided AND spread <= 0.10 AND depth (>= 5 at each best level and >= 100 within 5c of each side) AND not started (one decision per match: any platform live, or the earliest stated start passed) AND not a best-of-2 (a draw is possible - the price is not a win probability). Polymarket = midpoint of team A's outcome token (complements of one market, no de-vig); Kalshi = midpoint of team A's own YES contract. Disagreement flagged at |pA_poly - pA_kalshi| >= 0.05.
thunderpick_rule: Thunderpick (primary bookmaker source): a price is used only when the match is in Thunderpick's latest successful answer, that answer is at most 4500 s old (75 min since 2026-10-16; our retrieval time - the feed publishes no quote time), the market is the event-level 'Match Winner' (read as the series winner from its label - two outcomes, no draw price; not provider-confirmed), the format is best-of-1, 3 or 5, and the match has not started (the feed has no live flag). Decimal odds d -> raw implied chance 1/d (the two add up to more than 100% by the bookmaker margin) -> market-implied probability = each raw implied chance divided by their sum (proportional margin removal). Listed odds only: the feed gives no stake limits or execution confirmation.
